summary.headline: Antiochus’s Astrological Chapters
summary.text: Catalog of astrological chapters from the treasuries of Antiochus, covering zodiacal signs, star sects, exaltations and depressions, oppositions, trigonal lordship, decans, fixed stars, degrees, aspects, lots, lunar phases, and related topics; an excerpt of Teucer the Babylonian is noted, with an edition reference to Catal. Florent., pages 140–164.
